name: Fix derived-state auto-commit (EXP-AUTO-COMMIT-001) to skip gitignored paths
goal: autoCommitDerivedState (src/cli/synth.ts ~351) builds an explicit git add path list that includes .synth/data/drafts/ (gitignored), causing the whole git add to error and the derived-state commit to abort, leaving event-log.jsonl/canonical-state.json staged-but-uncommitted after lifecycle transitions. Fix: exclude gitignored/derived-excluded paths before git add (filter via git check-ignore, or use git add -A which skips ignored). See attached finding.

metadata.cancelReason: Premise no longer holds: .synth/data/drafts/ is tracked, not gitignored (git check-ignore exits 1), and completed expedition ecc3688796be0545 'Derived-state staging correctness (auto-commit + ignore filtering)' delivered the ignore-filtering fix. Ceremony commits now stage draft files successfully, so the EXP-AUTO-COMMIT-001 failure mode is gone.
